notes: COLD RUN 9067. The club brief a fourth time, unchanged, closing the series 9060 / 9065 / 9066 / 9067. 9066 shipped 301 occluders and NONE of them reachable: run/main_scene is mission.tscn, which loads presentation/lux.applied.tscn and the dressing layer, while occluders.tscn was instanced only from the package-root site.tscn that nothing runs -- so a recipient paid the culler's per-frame cost with nothing to cull, and every occlusion figure this repo had published came from a probe naming a scene the mission never loads. LF 0.102.0 wires the holder into mission.tscn, bakes against that same scene, and audits by walking from run/main_scene DOWNWARD with a Godot runtime count as arbiter. WHAT WOULD FALSIFY THE CLAIM: a package whose running scene reaches zero occluders; draw calls that do not fall at the interior stations; occluders that cull something visible; or a package that needed hands. The run's own verdict counts as much as the frame figures.
